registration.statement: At positive orbit rank r, three-space supplies one central orientation and the rank-two boundary supplies one held pair for every predecessor step. Two exclusion-distinct Fold labels occupy each orientation, forcing capacity 2(1+2(r-1)) and the sequence 2, 6, 10, 14, 18 without observation.
registration.title: Atomic orbit-cell capacity from three-space boundary orientation
